meta.hypothesis: The 223×/796× box-normalised over-yield is a point-source dose-normalisation artifact; normalised by the LOCAL dose the fibre core receives, absolute yields land within ~5× of experiment (Ward 1988).
meta.passBar: Local-dose-normalised direct-SSB and DSB yields within 5× of experiment AND concentration factor C derived, not asserted.
meta.method: energy-deposition proxy = radical-creation positions; ionisation = H3O+ (species 3); C = frac_in_core × box/core volume ratio

sources.wardRef: Ward JF 1988, Prog Nucleic Acid Res Mol Biol 35:95 — ~35 DSB / ~1000 SSB per diploid cell per Gy, low-LET

assumptions: energy ∝ event count spatially (bounded: 98% of both all-events and ions in-core)
point source: primary.wgsl start_half=0 in the dumped run

summary.headline: Point source → 98.1% of energy in central 3µm → C=981, local dose 238 Gy (not 0.243). Local-normalised: SSB_dir 0.34×, DSB 0.82× exp. Box-norm 223×/796× was a dose artifact.

rows.note: DSB/SSB residual (3.57×) is unchanged by dose normalisation — that is the tuned-P_indirect / clustering issue, not absolute yield.
